Per-op device time over the same 4-replay signposted decode window, summed across every
memory-layout variant of each op code.

| op code | before (us/window) | after (us/window) | delta per replay |
|---|---|---|---|
| `TopKDeviceOperation` | 2,833.2 | 2,255.3 | -144.5 |
| `SliceDeviceOperation` | 350.1 | 496.2 | +36.5 |
| `ConcatDeviceOperation` | 109.1 | 206.3 | +24.3 |
| `GatherDeviceOperation` | 150.7 | 172.6 | +5.5 |
| `BinaryNgDeviceOperation` *(reported, not fitted)* | 689.5 | 704.9 | +3.8 |
| **sampler net** (top-k + machinery) | | | **-78.2** |
| **whole window** | 9,449.9 | 9,109.5 | **-85.1** |

The two coefficients, solved from those deltas:

* reduction: **0.1881 us per width unit** (3744 units at g=20 -> 2976 at g=32)
* grouping machinery (`SliceDeviceOperation`, `ConcatDeviceOperation`, `GatherDeviceOperation`): **5.52 us/replay per group**, so **177 us/replay** of grouping at g=32 (the raw `Slice`+`Concat`+`Gather` total is 219 us/replay, but that also contains the decoder's own slices, so it is only an upper bound)

so `device(g) ~= 0.188 * (W/g + 32g) + 5.52 * g + const`, minimised at
**g = 31.9** for W = 62464 - which is why the shipped g = 32 is the joint
optimum and not merely the best legal divisor. (The model reproducing the 20 -> 32 move it was solved from - 78.2 against 78.2 us/replay - is arithmetic, not validation. What checks the reduction coefficient independently is the two `TopK` rows of the after report on their own: 369 us at width 1952 and 195 us at width 1024 give 0.189 and 0.190 us per width unit, against the 0.188 solved here.)

Device time and wall time move at roughly 1:1 here: the whole-window delta above (-85.1 us/replay) against a **-88.4 us/token** wall delta on the 40-layer model (`perf_summary.json`'s `traced_decode_plus_sampling_no_readback`, 23.433 -> 23.345 ms).

### Candidates the model rejects

| candidate | reduction | machinery | extra ops | net |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| pad to 1980 tiles, g=44 (+896 columns/device) | -24 us | +66 us | +4 us of LM head | **+46 us** |
| three-stage, g=99 / h=11 on 1980 tiles (1280 units) | -319 us | +431 us | +43 us second index gather | **+155 us** |

Both are net worse, and the sign does not depend on the exact split: the machinery term is
linear in the group count while the reduction term is only `W/g`.

The remaining lever is the machinery itself - **177 us/replay** at g=32, all of
it op-launch overhead for what is arithmetically a free reinterpretation of the logits tensor.
